review.identity: bunny-alpha-1/bunny-alpha-1 (self-review of the implementer's own branch)
review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of cs_app::objectives::survey_retail_detached_declarations over the installation (detached-vocabulary-census.json). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: every reader archive in the installation was opened, its objectives.zrd member decoded with the production .zrd reader and read through cs_content::objectives::measure_detached_vocabulary; over 62 archives (53 mission-scoped and 9 shared/world-group, the denominator F39-D's census did not have) the installation declares 3244 counted-condition names (191 distinct), 758 objective-kind names (170 distinct) and 3523 block-declaration names (1284 distinct). VERDICT detached_is_an_event_not_a_counted_category: 0 sites on either surface that could declare a category spell the contract's own DETACH stem, and 0 spell any other stem of the published twelve-stem family except the 1 objective kind(s) and 24 block declaration(s) listed in the census artifact; every one of the 7 DROP sites is a block declaration of an OBJECTIVE<N> block, never a counted condition. WHERE A DETACHED ACTOR IS REPRESENTED INSTEAD: the release/attach path, which keeps objective identity rather than ending the actor's life (cs_sim::world_actors::release::release_payload carries objective: Option<SymbolId> across the release; cs_content::animation::AttachmentOp::Detach is the authored op), and the lifecycle transition that leaves mission accounting without counting anything is LifecycleKind::MissionRemoved, which cs_sim::objectives::counters::CountKind::from_lifecycle answers None for. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED: (1) the negative is a measured absence of the SPELLING over a published twelve-stem segment-prefix list, not a proof that the original has no notion of a detached actor - a name spelled outside those stems would not be found; (2) the compiled mission program behind each record is not decoded at all, because the mission-language instruction table is unmeasured (F13-B/C, F38 own it); (3) what satisfying an INACTIVE<n> condition means is unmeasured (F39-E1), so even a name that had spelled a category here would not have been a readable rule; (4) no original executable was run, so nothing here is evidence of how the original behaves, only of what its files declare; (5) whether an original RECORD may declare one of the five counted categories is decided in one place, cs_content::objectives::original_count_category_refusal (F39-E4), and this task neither restates nor widens that census. `unknowns` is empty because every unresolved item above is a limit on the claim rather than an unresolved measurement: every row of the census resolved. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
